questions.text: When using Dijkstra’s algorithm to find shortest path in a graph, which of the following statement is not true?
options: It can find shortest path within the same graph data structure
Every time a new node is visited, we choose the node with smallest known distance/cost (weight) to visit first
Shortest path always passes through least number of vertices
The graph needs to have a non-negative weight on every edge
questions.correct_answer: Shortest path always passes through least number of vertices

questions.text: The browser establishes a TCP connection with the server, but displays a blank page or keeps loading indefinitely. What is the MOST likely issue?
options: The server did not call listen()
The HTTP response is missing proper headers (e.g., Content-Type or Content- Length)
The client used IPv6 instead of IPv4
The socket buffer size is too small
questions.correct_answer: The HTTP response is missing proper headers (e.g., Content-Type or Content- Length)

questions.text: The server successfully receives and prints the HTTP request, but the browser shows “This site can’t be reached” or keeps loading. What is the most likely reason?
options: The server did not call bind()
The server did not send an HTTP response back to the client
The browser used HTTPS instead of HTTP
The request buffer size was too small
questions.correct_answer: The server did not send an HTTP response back to the client

questions.text: You modify the server to accept a connection and immediately close it after reading a request: [IMAGE: /data/images/cs4024_2026T1_ET_FN_p3_Im1.webp|block] When you open http://127.0.0.1:8080/ in a browser, it shows an error like “Connection reset” or keeps retrying. On the server side, no errors are printed. What is the most likely reason?
options: The server does not send any HTTP response before closing the connection.
The buffer size is too small to hold the HTTP request.
The browser requires UDP instead of TCP for HTTP.
The server must call write() before read().
questions.correct_answer: The server does not send any HTTP response before closing the connection.
